xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5347: Composer / menu: list skills under a labeled Skills group

plan.title: Composer / menu: list skills under a labeled Skills group
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: The dashboard composer's / menu (getSlashCommands in src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/chat/slashCommands.ts) has four sources (harness native commands, /handoff, the pan CLI manifest, curated variants) and none of them lists skills. Typing /pan-cons finds nothing although pan-consolidate-conversations is installed and enabled, so operators cannot discover skill-only workflows such as pan-flywheel or pan-recap from the composer.
narratives.Proposal: Add a harness capability skillSlashCommands (true for Claude Code only). Extend GET /api/skills/overrides with conversation=<name> and cwd=<path> (plus the existing issue=<id>): a known row resolves skill states the way a launch of that conversation does (resolveLaunchScope from the row's cwd and issue, plus the row's skill map as the conversation layer); without a row (agent-session views) the given cwd and issue are used. A new frontend module chat/skillSlashCommands.ts builds that context from the conversation, fetches the list with plain fetch when the slash menu opens, and maps enabled native skills (core included; pan, pan-handoff, handoff excluded) to SlashCommand rows in category 'Skills'. getSlashCommands(harness, skillCommands) appends them last, gated on the capability. ComposerPromptEditor takes a skillContext prop and ComposerFooter passes skillContextForConversation(conversation). Docs: configuration/harnesses.mdx, configuration/skills.mdx, docs/CONTEXT-LAYERS.md, changelog.d/pan-5347.md, codebase map architecture.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Pack skills (/<pack>:<skill>) in the menu.
- Skills for any harness other than Claude Code; Codex, Pi and the rest declare skillSlashCommands false.
- Skills for linked (other-machine) or vault conversations, or for synthetic sessions with no cwd (for example a specialist pane with cwd '').
- Reflecting toggles made after launch inside the running harness; the menu shows the current resolved state only.
- Honoring user-invocable: false frontmatter.
- Changing how composer text is delivered to the harness.
- Changing the Settings skills page, the new-conversation skills field, or PUT /api/skills/overrides.
- Using react-query useQuery anywhere in the ComposerFooter subtree.
- Moving the existing Overdeck, native or Conversation groups or changing their category labels.
- Adding a new HTTP route (the change is a query parameter on an existing route).

autoDecisions.summary: Gate skills with a new HarnessCapabilities field skillSlashCommands, true only for Claude Code.
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-4562 requires per-harness decisions to read a declared capability. Claude Code runs a skill from /<skill>; for Codex, Pi and the other harnesses /<skill> as a skill invocation is not verified, so they declare false rather than insert text that may do nothing.

autoDecisions.summary: Resolve the skill scope on the server via conversation=<name>, cwd=<path> and issue=<id> on GET /api/skills/overrides instead of passing project and issue from the frontend; a known row wins, otherwise cwd and issue are used.
autoDecisions.rationale: The frontend Conversation has no skill map and projectKey is usually null (project comes from cwd); the launcher's resolveLaunchScope plus the row's skillOverrides is what decides which skills Claude Code hides. Agent-session views pass synthetic conversations (id 0 or -1) with no row, so cwd and issue are the fallback, matching a work-agent launch. It is a parameter on an existing route, so no no-loss-matrix row is needed.

autoDecisions.summary: List native skills only; exclude pack skills.
autoDecisions.rationale: Pack skill ids are pack/skill in the API but pack:skill in the harness and the Deft adapter renames them; including them needs separate verification and is better as a follow-up.

autoDecisions.summary: Append the Skills block after all existing sources.
autoDecisions.rationale: Putting skills first would let a skill whose description contains 'pan sync' take the top row and steal Enter from /pan sync; last keeps every existing selection and keyboard order unchanged.

autoDecisions.summary: Fetch with plain fetch inside ComposerPromptEditor only when the slash menu opens, refetching on each open.
autoDecisions.rationale: heldKickoff.tsx documents that useQuery in the ComposerFooter subtree breaks test files without a QueryClientProvider, and ComposerFooter.test.tsx asserts no extra fetch on mount; the ComposerFooter tests mock ComposerPromptEditor, so a menu-open fetch there touches none of them. Refetching on open reflects Settings toggles without a cache.

autoDecisions.summary: Exclude skills named pan, pan-handoff and handoff from the Skills group.
autoDecisions.rationale: ComposerFooter intercepts /pan … as a portable Overdeck command and /pan-handoff or /handoff as the handoff dialog, so those skills never reach the harness from the composer.

Core skills are always enabled and the issue names pan-flywheel as a skill operators cannot find; the existing ConversationSkillsField drops core skills because they cannot be toggled, which does not apply to a launcher menu.

autoDecisions.summary: Linked and vault conversations get no Skills group.
autoDecisions.rationale: Their skills live on another machine; the local catalog would list skills the owning harness may not have.

autoDecisions.summary: When the conversation's issue has no owning project and its cwd gives none, retry the listing with the project only (global).
autoDecisions.rationale: This is the existing D8 fallback from ConversationSkillsField, moved server-side because the client now sends only the conversation name.

autoDecisions.summary: Live browser UAT is an acceptance criterion on the last frontend item for the review/test roles, not a separate xBRIEF item.
autoDecisions.rationale: pan task done requires an Item: commit on the pushed branch, and verification produces no commit.

autoDecisions.summary: If live UAT shows Claude Code does not run a delivered /<skill>, stop and tell the flywheel instead of shipping the menu.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue says not to offer a skill where typing it would do nothing; changing message delivery is outside this issue.

metadata.sizeJustification: 21 files, under the 25-file limit. The 10-subsystem count is inflated by documentation and test locations (configuration/, docs/, changelog.d/, .overdeck/context/, scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt, tests/unit/). The code touches four areas: one contracts field, one skill-overrides lib module, one existing route, and one frontend chat directory. Splitting into sibling issues would ship either a server query parameter that no caller uses or a menu that cannot resolve the conversation's skill scope, and neither half is independently useful to an operator.
